about: Script to B-roll: the same shot lists from crates/editor/src/broll.rs and apps/web/src/broll/plan.ts. Queries keep a line's three longest uncommon words in order; shots follow the voice-over's lines and pauses, timed at the given words a second (at least 1.5 s).
